name: Menu
notes: The first screen. It loads the saved progress (which monsters are unlocked, the last pick), then the MONSTER SURVIVAL logo drops in over the meadow and bounces twice, a white flash, then the monster picker appears: Left / Right browse the 9 monsters (each slides in and cries), with that monster's best time (fastest won run) above it, START begins the run with it. The first 3 monsters (Furrbit, Emberpup, Splashell) are playable at first; the first won run of each monster unlocks the next monster in the roster (winning again with one that already won unlocks nothing), and the locked ones show as dark silhouettes. A save from an older version with fewer than 3 unlocked is raised to 3. SELECT asks whether to clear the saved progress (unlocks and best times). Coming back from a run, the last pick is still selected.
